Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the "seconds" part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Simple Series Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on MIAX for the current session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on MIAX system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted Option value

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long Term Option value

Field.Name: Active on MIAX
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on MIAX in the current session

Field.Name: MIAX BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by MIAX

Field.Name: Liquidity Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote/Order acceptance as per MIAX rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Priority Quote Width
Field.Description: Maximum allowable width for a quote for this Option during regular trading in order to be considered as Priority Quote. 0 when Priority Quote Width is not applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Definition Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate stock option strategies traded on MIAX for the current session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this Strategy is added/updated on MIAX system today.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: MIAX Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for this strategy

Field.Name: Active on MIAX
Field.Description: Indicates if this strategy is tradable on MIAX in the current session

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Update Reason
Field.Description: Update Reason value

Field.Name: Reserved 10
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of Legs. Variable from 2 to 8

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify the firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to each Underlying group. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: AIS Version
Field.Description: Eg: AIS2.0

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID for the current trading session

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status

Message.Name: Simple Liquidity Seeking Event Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate information each time a Liquidity seeking event (defined in Event Type field below) starts at MIAX.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this notification was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O': always 0. When Event Type is 'L', 'R', or 'P': Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Current price of the Event. Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This is the side of the excess liquidity that is waiting to get matched. Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 1
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O', 'L', 'R', or 'P': MatchQty - Number of contracts ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present). Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 2
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O', 'L' or 'R': Routable Quantity. Number of contracts that may be routed. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 3
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O', 'L' or 'R': Imbalance Quantity. Number of contracts on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 4
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O', 'L' or 'R': Must Fill Quantity. Number of contracts, on the provided Side, that must be matched at the provided Price. These contracts are crossing the provided Price and MIAX is seeking liquidity for these contracts. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned Attributable ID (Executing Broker MPID) of an Order. Otherwise, it is space filled.

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Origin of either the single liquidity which initiated the event or origins of multiple liquidities which initiated the event if they are all of identical origin.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Complex Liquidity Seeking Event Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate information each time a Liquidity seeking event (defined in Event Type field below) starts at MIAX

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this notification was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: MIAX Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side. When Event Type is 'P': Agency side of the cPRIME order being auctioned

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net limit price for the strategy. When Event Type is 'P': Auction Start Price of the cPRIME auction

Field.Name: Matched Quantity
Field.Description: Number of strategies ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present).

Field.Name: Imbalance Quantity
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'C': Number of strategies on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Even Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned Attributable ID (Executing Broker MPID) of the Order. Otherwise, it is space filled.

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Origin of either the single liquidity which initiated the event or origins of multiple liquidities which initiated the event if they are all of identical origin.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Underlying Trading Status Notification Message
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of all the options of an underlying.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status value

Field.Name: Event Reason
Field.Description: Event Reason value

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Seconds Part
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Always use in conjunction with the Nano-seconds part field.

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Nano-Seconds Part
Field.Description: Nano-seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Specifies number of nano-seconds since the seconds specified in "Expected Event Time Seconds" field.

Message.Name: Theoretical Settlement Reference Price Notification Message
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of the current state and Theoretical Settlement Reference Price (TSRP) or Final Settlement Reference Price (FSRP) of each option involved in settlement, on the settlement day, until the Final Settlement Price is determined.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike Price of the Option

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Option State
Field.Description: Option State

Field.Name: Prior Day Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference Price of the option used for Index calculation at the end of the prior trading day

Field.Name: Settlement Reference Price
Field.Description: Current Settlement Reference Price (SRP) of the Option could be theoretical (TSRP) or final (FSRP)

Field.Name: Settlement Reference Price Type
Field.Description: Type of the Settlement Reference Price

Field.Name: SAO Buy Quantity 1
Field.Description: All open SAO Buy liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: SAO Sell Quantity 1
Field.Description: All open SAO Sell liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: SAO Buy Quantity 2
Field.Description: All open SAO Buy liquidity at all prices

Field.Name: SAO Sell Quantity 2
Field.Description: All open SAO Sell liquidity at all prices

Field.Name: Non SAO Buy Quantity
Field.Description: All open non-SAO Buy liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: Non SAO Sell Quantity
Field.Description: All open non-SAO Sell liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: Total Buy Quantity
Field.Description: Total SAO and non-SAO open Buy liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: Total Sell Quantity
Field.Description: Total SAO and non-SAO open Sell liquidity priced equal to or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price, including Market Orders

Field.Name: Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This is the side of the excess liquidity that is waiting to get matched

Field.Name: Imbalance Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched either at a price equal or better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price or at expected opening price.

Field.Name: Must Fill Quantity
Field.Description: Number of unmatched contracts, on the provided Side, that must be matched at the price better than the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price.

Field.Name: Matched Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present) at the Theoretical Settlement Reference Price.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Current Opening Condition

Field.Name: MBB
Field.Description: MIAX Best Quote Bid

Field.Name: MBO
Field.Description: MIAX Best Quote Offer

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Theoretical Settlement Price Notification Message
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of the Theoretical Settlement Price, on the settlement day, until the Final Settlement Price is determined.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Settlement Symbol
Field.Description: Settlement Symbol

Field.Name: Theoretical Settlement Price
Field.Description: Theoretical Settlement Price

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Option leg: MIAX Defined Series. See Simple Series Update Message. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Leg Ratio Qty
Field.Description: The ratio of this individual leg. Number of option contracts or Number of stock shares for this leg is: LegRatioQty * OrderQty

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: The side of this individual leg

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: MIAX will accept position closing orders only

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: MIAX will accept open and close positions

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Far month expiration (as defined by MIAX rules)

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: Near month expiration (as defined by MIAX rules)

Value.Name: Penny Or Nickel
Value.Description: Penny if Price <= $3, Nickel if Price > $3

Value.Name: Nickel Or Dime
Value.Description: Nickel if Price <= $3, Dime if Price > $3

Value.Name: Penny Or Nickel
Value.Description: Penny if Price <= $3, Nickel if Price > $3

Value.Name: Nickel Or Dime
Value.Description: Nickel if Price <= $3, Dime if Price > $3

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: MIAX has halted trading for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Resumed
Value.Description: MIAX will resume trading (reopen) for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Opened
Value.Description: MIAX will open trading for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Automatic
Value.Description: This event resulted from automatic/market driven event
